title: Thin, over priced.
text:
Thin, over priced.. This is a cute colorful Tortilla warmer, but very thin.
I have been using two warmers I already have, but thought I needed a new one.
I keep my Tortillas in the freezer , then when I need them put them in this then in microwave
To heat them up. This did not defrost or warm them even.
This is thin, small and over priced

product_metadata.title: Tortillada - 12 Inch Tortilla Warmer/Heat Container microwaveable made of cotton/polyester (Black)
features: 𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐈𝐋𝐋𝐀 𝐖𝐀𝐑𝐌𝐄𝐑 - In this tortilla warmer you can warm up to 15 tortillas at the same time. The warmer can be put in the microwave for this purpose.
𝐒𝐔𝐈𝐓𝐀𝐁𝐋𝐄 - The Tortilla Warmer is suitable for homemade tortillas as well as for those bought in the supermarket.
𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐕𝐄𝐑𝐒𝐀𝐋 - Our tortilla warmer from Tortillada is suitable for a wide range of flat breads: tortillas, roti, chapati etc.
𝐌𝐈𝐂𝐑𝐎𝐖𝐀𝐕𝐄 - Simply put the warmer with the flat bread inside in the microwave for 30 - 40 seconds and it is perfect for immediate consumption.
𝐖𝐀𝐒𝐇𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐌𝐀𝐂𝐇𝐈𝐍𝐄 - Our tortilla warmer can be easily washed in the washing machine at 86°F.
